title: Dialysis
description: Dialysis is a lifesaving treatment that removes waste and excess water from your blood when your kidneys can no longer do this job. Two main types exist: hemodialysis (filtering blood through an artificial kidney machine) and peritoneal dialysis (using your abdominal lining to filter blood). The type of dialysis recommended depends on your kidney function level, lifestyle, and medical status. Most dialysis patients require three sessions per week, each lasting 3-5 hours. With proper dialysis and medical management, patients with kidney failure can enjoy good quality of life.
